knowledge.starter: consumer-apos-1.3.0 includes all five v0.2 components, evidence-calibrated context budgets, deterministic session bootstrap, DataMap and generated human projections
knowledge.runtime: APOS v0.1 transactional bootstrap remains unchanged; APOS v0.2 profiles are governed configuration until native runtime support
knowledge.architecture: maturity and complexity are evaluated per domain
knowledge.context: session bootstrap indexes current state and open work before selective compilation; checkpoint generates project memory plus open and resolved Intent reports without replacing canonical records
knowledge.coordination: optional workstreams expose ownership and dependencies across teams without granting authority or duplicating Intent details
knowledge.data_governance: ProductState carries a typed pointer to a dedicated versioned DataMap for entities, relationships, lineage, classification and retention
knowledge.recovery: reconstruction is governed as a chain across Git, IaC, data, objects, identity, secrets, external configuration and tested restore; the starter includes a provider-neutral Recovery Manifest
knowledge.onboarding: root README links a 30-minute guide; explicit Intent and Decision compile in an isolated consumer fixture
knowledge.ai_execution: Codex remains human-assisted; API automation starts only as a bounded evaluated pilot
knowledge.capability_ontology: The v2 map contains 14 macro domains and 130 capabilities plus a Commercial Model cross-domain layer; composition ontology is separate from epistemic source authority; coverage defaults to absent and rises only with versioned evidence
knowledge.commercial_model: Commercial Model is an Economic Control Plane that propagates actor incentives, billable events, entitlements, guardrails and second-order impacts through the domain graph without granting implicit authority
knowledge.mission: Reduce technological entry barriers for new businesses to practically zero through reusable, secure and verifiable agentic product foundations
knowledge.llm_engineering: Domínio definido com política, template, contexto e registro epistêmico; não altera enforcement nem promove modelos.
